Class TimeUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.utils.aclocks.TimeUtils

  • public abstract class TimeUtils

      • toNanos

        public static long toNanos(double d,
                           java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit u)
        convert a duration expressed as a double with a time unit to its equivalent in nanoseconds.

        Contract

         pre     d >= 0
 pre     u != null
 post    ret > 0
        Parameters:
        d - a duration.
        u - the time unit interpreting d.
        Returns:
        the duration in nanoseconds as a long.

      • convert

        public static double convert(long t,
                             java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit from,
                             java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit to)
        convert the time value t expressed in the time unit from to its equivalent the time unit to.

        Contract

         pre     true        // no precondition.
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        t - a time value expressed in the from time unit.
        from - a time unit in which t is expressed.
        to - a time unit in which the result must be expressed.
        Returns:
        the equivalent of t in the to time unit.
